proposal_title: Security Model Secret Handling Prose & Redaction Rules Formalization
domain_specific_rationale: Formally ratifying the updated security model and ADR-007 cements the requirement for runtime secret injection, buffer zeroing, and strict telemetry redaction into normative architectural specifications. From an observability standpoint, this eliminates contradictory claims (such as non-existent hardware enclaves) and establishes clear contractual boundaries for R14's logging/tracing SDK, ensuring uniform redaction of tokens, cookies, and credentials across all 15 AVF repositories.
capability_impact: Protects CAP-07 (Security & Isolation) and CAP-14 (Platform Observability) by establishing consistent, verifiable telemetry sanitation rules.
residual_risk: Potential discrepancies between individual service logging implementations if they bypass the R14 shared telemetry wrapper. Mitigate with mandatory CI contract tests verifying that raw log payloads and span attributes pass redaction filters.
